verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a model selector drop-down under the prompt box for choosing the reasoning model. Hands-on community reports confirm the choices span providers: Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and GPT-OSS 120B, and the product is "not locked to just Gemini models." Missing for 10: a first-party list of supported providers and models, and documentation of model selection in the CLI and SDK rather than only the conversation UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Users can select which reasoning model they want to use within the model selector drop-down under the conversation prompt box
with support for Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and GPT-OSS 120B models
Nice to see that it's not locked to just Gemini models.
